recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the applied Jira resolution; generated/rendered artifacts can be refreshed by the normal publisher process if they display additional bindings.
issue_request: FHIR-50021 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI change request for R6 asking that Measure.reportingFrequency Quantity units be restricted to frequency units, with an extensible common UCUM frequency value set and a max binding for all units convertible to frequency.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR #3932 implementation added source/measure/valueset-frequency-unit.xml and an extensible Measure.reportingFrequency binding, with a follow-up QA commit correcting the value set URL. That application did not add the second max/all-frequency binding described in the Jira resolution.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini and Measure.reportingFrequency is a current R6 element. The current additional-binding-purpose code system deprecates purpose 'maximum' as equivalent to 'required', so the reconciliation represents the max binding as a required additional binding.
reconciliation: Added source/measure/valueset-all-frequency-units.xml using the UCUM canonical filter /a, and added it to Measure.reportingFrequency as a required additional binding while preserving the existing extensible common-frequency binding.
source_changes: source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml: added a required additional binding from Measure.reportingFrequency to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/all-frequency-units.
source/measure/valueset-all-frequency-units.xml: added a CQI-owned all-frequency UCUM ValueSet using canonical = /a.
